answer: One defence is Proof of unique bank account via micro-deposit: a micro-deposit only the account holder sees, and the gale of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Fakes fail here because a micro-deposit only the account holder sees is tied to something outside the network; the anchor of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The sable grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
